description: Semantic regression cases for canonical subject classification and knowledge hierarchy promotion.

cases.existing_shape: One project document has several sections for architecture, delivery, risks, and decisions.
cases.incoming_material: A daily note adds another delivery update for the same project.
review_checks: All sections describe one durable subject.
No independently maintained child concept or useful routing level is introduced.
Source-artifact form does not create a new canonical concept.

cases.existing_shape: The index uses stable headings for Engineering Initiatives, External Integrations, and Meeting Notes while all concepts remain direct siblings.
cases.incoming_material: Another durable external interface must be ingested beside existing independently maintained integration concepts.
review_checks: The subgroup is a reusable semantic routing choice rather than presentation only.
Existing integration concepts move before another integration sibling is added.
The parent index links only to the child collection and other direct children.
The child index routes only to its direct canonical concepts.
Moved concepts preserve metadata, provenance, and updated links.

cases.existing_shape: One index heading highlights current renovation work but does not define a reusable class among independent subjects.
cases.incoming_material: A second note updates the same renovation concept.
review_checks: The heading is temporary presentation rather than a durable routing decision.
No empty or speculative collection is created.
The existing canonical concept remains the destination.

cases.existing_shape: A project depends on one durable external integration with its own canonical concept.
cases.incoming_material: A source describes the dependency from the project perspective.
review_checks: Each durable subject keeps one primary path.
The secondary relationship is represented by Markdown links.
Knowledge is not duplicated under both branches.

cases.existing_shape: Several concepts could be projects, systems, integrations, or event records and the project has no trusted classification decision.
cases.incoming_material: A new source would extend the same mixed flat branch.
review_checks: Inbox Ingester does not invent a project taxonomy.
The source remains pending while identity or ownership is unresolved.
Flat growth is not used to hide the unresolved promotion decision.
